gameName: Trekking the National Parks: Second Edition
editionLabel: Underdog English second edition, 8-page publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited a national park goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the First Player Token. Turns proceed clockwise, with two actions per turn.
The token also identifies the final turn order: finish the last round so that everyone has the same number of turns.
This answer covers the second edition identified in the publisher’s download and credits.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 1, 2, 4, 7, 8. Setup step 8 gives the First Player Token and first turn to the latest visitor to a national park. Gameplay confirms clockwise individual turns with two actions each. The final round ends with the player to the starter’s right; Park Card and stone tie-breaks apply only to final scoring. Credits explicitly identify Second Edition development by Underdog Games. The publisher’s legacy page is labeled for the second edition; this is not the separately offered third-edition manual. No printing year is inferred from the URL timestamp.
